fields.FIR_Description: On 2025-04-07 around 10:05 hrs, it was reported that an investment offer shared in a messaging group led the complainant to deposit Rs. 1,85,000, after which contact ended. Transactions from the account SYN-ACC-100072, held by the complainant, were referred to in the complaint. A witness, Harish Babu, reachable on 9000000422, was mentioned in the complaint. The complaint mentions Murugan Karuppasamy, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000309, in connection with the events. Ajith Murugan (9000000225), described as a co-worker, was also mentioned in the complaint. Items referenced in the complaint: physical documents.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Initial small payouts allegedly used to build trust before larger deposits.
fields.Keywords: investment fraud, high returns, associate, mobile number, documents, ATM area, bank account, morning
